other_conditions: Must be a resident of Uttarakhand.
Must be engaged in any building or construction work.
Must be registered under the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers’ Welfare Board with active membership.
Must wait at least three months after registration before becoming eligible.
Must not have previously received the solar light/lantern benefit under any other scheme.
The benefit can be received only once in the beneficiary’s lifetime, even if both spouses are registered.
Family is considered as one unit, including spouse, dependent parents, sons below 21 years, and unmarried daughters.
benefits_summary: A one‑time provision of a solar light/lantern (LED/CFL) to eligible building and construction workers.
